line_text: "City's off limits till further notice!" That's all they said before lockin' us down here. No explanation, nothin'. Little while ago I heard it was 'cause there was a parade for some important person from the Empire. What did they think we'd try to do? / The people that live up in the city don't care what happened before, so long as they're good and comfortable now. Vayne tells 'em what they wanna hear, and they eat it up. He probably has 'em goin' on about how great he is already. / Plenty of people out there are happy, so long as there isn't a war. Well, if this is peace, I don't see what's so great about it. / The watch has been pretty lax lately. Probably distracted by the death of the Emperor. Ya ask me, this is the chance we been waitin' for. / Grown-ups never cease to amaze me. When we first moved down to Lowtown, they said they couldn't live in such a place. Now they pay it no mind. I don't know if they're just being brave, or strong... Or maybe they've just given up. / We live at the whim of the Empire. If the mood takes them, they can force us to do whatever they like. The masters of our destiny. / I've heard a rumor that the Imperial fleet was destroyed, but it's hard to be happy about it. Think of all the poor people who must've died. / The tragedy on Bur-Omisace, the Emperor's death, and now rumors of a resistance on the move... The world is rife with dangers, but Rabanastre has remained safe. I find it...disturbing. / Back before the war, I led a fine life up in the city. But I refused to bow my head to the Imperials, so they took everything I had and forced me to live here in Lowtown. / Back before the war, I led a fine life up in the city. (snort) I hate to think of them using my wealth to strengthen the Imperial army. / Everything I owned was confiscated after the war. Now I'm forced to live out my miserable days here. Suffering here because of the Empire, I feel I'm more of a Dalmascan than I ever was before. Ironic, don't you think? / Seems Marquis Ondore is finally on the move. Had I known what he was planning, I'd have given my money to him, rather than see the Empire take it. If he really is leading a resistance, maybe there's still hope we might someday be free of these Archadians. / A new Imperial Consul? What difference does it make? I don't care if they send the Emperor himself, Rabanastre belongs to Dalmasca. / People have high hopes for Vayne, but I'd say they're being rather naive. It takes more than well-meant words to rule a city. / The village in the Estersand is one of the few places we can go to escape the burdens of the city. I find the peace and quiet refreshing. / At night, I find myself wishing I could sleep forever. I'm just so tired... / They've got a thief trapped in the storehouse. A group of the children chased her through the Garamsythe Waterway before cornering her here. / Samal is a good man. I know few people who would waive charges against a thief in exchange for the goods they'd stolen. But in spite of these most unusual circumstances, Samal is in the courtyard in the South Sprawl, same as ever. He's nothing if not grounded. / You actually recovered the stolen property? I must say, I am impressed! I couldn't possibly care less what happens to that thief, but I'm happy to know that Samal will not suffer from this robbery. / See that house on the corner? Well...it's empty now. You see, the man who'd been living there recently passed away. He had fled from Nabudis during the war, the poor dear. If I'm not mistaken, that seeq laughing in the shop just across the way was his landlord. / Look, over there by the door. Do you not see Milha crouched there? What might have happened? That is the house where the man from Nabudis had lived, but it has lain empty for some time now. I have recently heard tales of a...a ghost sighted not far from here. Might it have something to do with that? / Locked himself in the house for fear of a ghost, has he? Hmm... I might have mentioned before, but that is the house the man who fled Nabudis lived in...until he fell ill and passed away. Were it me, I would be more frightened to be alone in there. / The child who'd been hiding in the house has finally come out. I must confess, I am...relieved. That is the house the man from Nabudis rented. He was a kind man. I...I do not suppose that he was the sort to return in death to torment the living. No. Did you notice? The seeq landlord—usually so jovial—did not laugh while the child was shut in the house. He sighed sadly all the while. / Excuse me, do you think you could tell me where Old Dalan's house is? Of course, the South Sprawl. I never have a map when I need one. line_text: You've come about the bill? Wonderful! I had started to think I'd posted it in vain. I'll not mince words. So I went looking for it—to humor him, you see. Imagine my surprise when I found it was real! There was no way I could deal with it on my own, so I needed to call in a hunter. Will you hunt this ghost for me? (choices: Accept / Decline) / Thank you so much! I saw this ghost in the Garamsythe Waterway, just down through Storehouse 5. It's an apparition called a wraith... And I think it came to avenge the cruel slaying of rats and other poor denizens of the waterway. I'm not pointing fingers...it doesn't really matter who did these things. But this apparition is here, and it must be dealt with. I leave it to you. / I understand. Many people are scared of ghosts. I will wait for a hunter of greater courage to take on this hunt. / The poor thing is so afraid of this ghost, he's locked himself inside and refuses to come out. You must find and kill this apparition, this wraith. I saw it in the Garamsythe Waterway, just down through Storehouse 5. / You've done it? You've defeated the wraith? Thank you! Thank you so much! / ??? Th-The ghost is gone? (snort) / Gone for good! This young man hunted it for us. / Jovial Seeq Oh ho! You have finally come out, my little Deeg! / Deeg Papa! These people got rid of that ghost for me! Deeg is sorry for worrying you, papa. / Jovial Seeq It's not been easy being jovial with my son locked up in a vacant house. But now that all is well, it should not be so hard. (snort) / He does look happy, I'll admit. Thanks in large part to you. Oh, you didn't think—heavens, it wasn't my child! If you'd gotten the wrong impression, I apologize. Please take this in thanks for your successful hunt. There's a little something there from our jovial friend as well. / The poor little guy. What am I going to do?

line_text: Then what do you make of Ondore's proclamation? Are you suggesting they fooled even the Marquis?

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半
line_text: What if a Judge killed the King, not the Captain? That would explain everything, wouldn't it?

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半

line_text: Now there is the Basch that I remember.

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半
speaker: Basch
line_text: Then will you fight again at my side?

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半
line_text: His word alone convinces me of nothing!

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半
line_text: I'd take his word over that of a mouthpiece marquis! / Then you name Reks liar with him.

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半
line_text: My brother was no liar! / Just the opposite. Reks was the witness they needed. / They had to make it appear as if I'd killed the King—Reks bears no blame. / The Fates have willed it.

trigger: requested by 監督.ウォースラ将軍前半
line_text: So this is Reks's brother. / Your words may convince a child such as this, but they weigh far too lightly on the scales for my taste. / Our paths will remain separate.
